name: IEC photoelectric receiver: normally closed receiver - AC driven
aliases: photoelectric receiver Normally Closed Receiver - AC Driven
summary: Photoelectric receiver form: Normally Closed Receiver - AC Driven.
description: A photoelectric receiver evaluates light arriving from an associated emitter and provides the documented electrical response. This entry identifies the normally closed receiver - ac driven form in the publisher's IEC-context family.

An object crossing a conveyor beam can change the receiver output. The receiver tag should identify its optical partner and the controller input receiving its signal. The normally-closed designation starts with a conducting output or closed contact in the documented reference condition; operation changes that state. This is the AC-supplied form. Supply and switched output must be checked separately rather than substituting a DC sensor connection diagram.
Normally-open and normally-closed labels describe the documented electrical output form. They do not by themselves establish light-on or dark-on operation; confirm that setting with the device data.
